evidence_composition.SWAP_response: RM27 formal one-step and two-half q_swap(H) observations after RM28-CC01 datum mapping
evidence_composition.groundwater_response: canonical F-GC fixed-interface one-cell independent MODFLOW6 6.8.0 oracle

interpretation: RM27's q_swap(H) difference is real but the admitted one-cell groundwater response strongly constrains the resulting coupled head shift.
For the frozen 8.64-second one-cell case, changing from the one-step to the two-half SWAP endpoint changes the coupled hydraulic head by about 1.7e-10 m.
The resulting groundwater-transfer-volume difference is about 3.0e-11 m3 over 8.64 seconds and 1 m2.
That transfer difference is about 8.32e-7 of the surface irrigation volume and 2.52e-5 of the groundwater-transfer magnitude.
These are effect sizes only. Their smallness does not create an application-accuracy requirement.
nonclaims: RM28 does not define or calibrate a temporal acceptance threshold.
RM28 does not admit the three-model triangle.
RM28 does not qualify later irrigation-demand or crop-memory fidelity.
RM28 does not reinterpret F-GC44 numerical closure tolerances as application tolerances.
next_required_boundary: Decide whether the workstream can close as research/architecture-qualified but production-admission-blocked pending an independently supplied application temporal-fidelity requirement, rather than continuing to manufacture additional numerical diagnostics.
